name: html-real-form-single-form-fallback
description: A real static GET form with the same email + submit pairing as the div pseudo-form is owned once by the native form block and is never double-counted by div-based pseudo-form detection.

source_reference.notes: Guards against double emission: the form path owns the subtree, so div-based pseudo-form detection must not also fire for the form or any wrapper around it.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
